text: Mobile app development involves creating software for smartphones and tablets. One important aspect is responsive design, which ensures an app works well on different screen sizes. Developers must also choose between native and cross-platform approaches. Native apps are built for one platform, while cross-platform apps can run on both iOS and Android, saving time and money. After development, apps are usually published on app stores like Google Play or the Apple App Store. Performance is another key factor: users expect apps to load quickly and run smoothly. A slow or buggy app is often deleted immediately, so testing and optimization are essential steps in the development process.
